issues.detail: Cove diffuser band hidden behind the vault
issues.problem: Only the middle of the cove band shows bright. The inner part next to the grille, and the outer edge, show the vault surface instead, at 204, so the lit band shrinks to about 1-1.5x the grille width and gains a grey step. Cause: the cove is ONE flat strip tangent at tm = 0.1345 across t 0.004..0.265. The vault arch bends away from that tangent, so the strip's ends sit above the vault surface and the vault occludes them. The vault there has eFn 0.02-0.05 and baked x0.85, because the eFn's 0.85 branch only starts at |x| > 1.66 while the cove spans |x| 1.41-1.65. Lowering vault eFn in w6 made the occluded parts visibly grey.
issues.evidence: r7v/v6 row 300: 249 x3 samples, then 204 x3, then the grille. r6v had 247 then 227. Crop raterB7/cove_r7v.png against raterB7/c120_cove.png: in c120 the diffuser is one bright field up to the grille frame.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js buildCeilings, seat zone. (a) Build the cove as 4 sub-strips that follow the arc: for (let j=0;j<4;j++){ const ta=lerp(c0,c1,j/4), tb=lerp(c0,c1,(j+1)/4), A=vaultAt(ta), B=vaultAt(tb); upper.add(vaultStrip((ta+tb)/2, side, z0+0.03, z1-0.03, Math.hypot(B[0]-A[0],B[1]-A[1])+0.004, 0.0016), null, CEILMAT.cove); }. (b) As a belt-and-braces fix, change the vault eFn branch `if (ax > 1.66) return 0.85` to `if (ax > xg + TROUGH.w/2 + 0.012) return 0.85`, and skip the baked factor there (f = 1 when |x| > xg + 0.035), so any vault seen through the cove reads as cove.
